title: iranecio taraxacifolius
intro: Iranecio taraxacifolius, commonly known as the dandelion leaf taraxacifolius, is a plant species within the genus Iranecio and the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its use as a diuretic to aid in urinary tract issues. The therapeutic actions of Iranecio taraxacifolius may be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
